answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake and earn weight only through verified completed work, so trust is a bridge built over time, not claimed at registration. New identities start at the nadir of influence: zero payout weight until they complete audited tasks, and a failed audit slashes the stake and quarantines the harbor of accounts linked by funding or behavior. An attacker must therefore fund, age, and successfully operate each fake identity, making a thousand-sybil flood cost a thousand stakes plus a thousand work histories instead of one script.
